title: Annual Four-Item Review and Follow-Up Arrangements
prompt: In many workplaces, a formal annual review now covers four items: performance, budget use, staff development, and future planning. Some managers argue that such a broad review creates unnecessary paperwork and distracts employees from their daily work. Others believe it gives a clearer overall picture and leads to better follow-up arrangements. What problems can arise from conducting a four-item annual review, and what solutions would you recommend to make the review more useful for both staff and the organization? Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟雅思学术类写作Task 2练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试卷。请先明确题目要求你讨论的两个方面：四项年度验收可能带来的问题，以及你建议的改进方案。写作时需立场清晰，每个主体段围绕一个核心观点展开，并用解释或例子支撑。注意题目要求至少250词，建议用约40分钟完成，写完后检查是否同时回应了“problems”和“solutions”两个问题。
